text:
anya: Quick q — should the Notify API expose an estimated_fanout / quiet_score for the SLO console? Console PMs want a per-rule projected #notifications so tenants can see cost impact before enabling a rule.

miguel: I'd be cautious. Exposing routing/estimate logic in the main API couples product surfaces and could add perf risk if callers hit it often. Prefer telemetry-only unless console truly needs realtime.

devon: Middle ground: add a lightweight estimate endpoint (dry-run) that reuses routing logic but never sends. /notify/estimate. Cache results and rate-limit. That gives console what it needs without changing send path.

sarah: Important: estimates must not leak recipient identities or mapping. We can return counts by channel only (email/slack/sms) and a total. No user IDs.

miguel: +1 on counts-only. Also add ETag/caching so console polling doesn't hammer the route. TTL maybe 30–120s depending on rule volatility.

anya: Console wants breakdown by channel and a projected cost column. counts-by-channel is sufficient. UX will show: projected (p95), historical avg, and the rule toggle.

devon: example payload/response I'm thinking: 

```
GET /v1/notify/estimate?rule_id=r-123
Request body: { "signal": {"slo":0.92} }

200 OK
{
  "est_total": 42,
  "by_channel": {"email": 30, "slack": 10, "sms": 2},
  "p95_estimate": 60,
  "cache_ttl_secs": 60
}
```

sarah: Telemetry side still needs to emit actual fanout per execution (counts, dedupe, sent vs attempted) so we can compare estimate accuracy and surface regressions in the console.

anya: What about quota accounting? If console shows an estimate and actual exceeds it, customers could be surprised and bill unexpectedly. We should label estimate clearly and show historical variance.

miguel: Also add a safety margin in the UI (show p95) and a note that estimates exclude downstream retry inflation. Ops: add alerts if actual/predicted ratio > 2x for a tenant.

devon: Implementation notes: reuse notify routing engine in dry-run mode. Cost-wise it's cheaper than full send but not free — limit estimate calls to internal console tokens and rate-limit per-tenant (e.g., 1/min). Consider pre-computing estimates for high-traffic rules and caching at the job level.

sarah: Security: require a new scope `notify:estimate` and log audit events whenever an estimate is requested. Also add telemetry field `estimate_requested=true` so we can detect abuse.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Heads up — routing changes landing in next Wed window. Do we want to ship estimate endpoint in that window? :eyes:

miguel: I'd prefer a feature-flagged rollout. Prototype behind FF, then opt-in a few customers before enabling broadly.

anya: Agreement path: devon -> prototype estimate endpoint (FF) -> miguel -> add auth, rate-limits, caching -> sarah -> emit telemetry hooks and audit events -> anya -> wire console UI (show p95 + historical).

anya: Owners: devon (proto), miguel (auth/limits), sarah (telemetry), anya (console wiring). I'll create a short RFC/implementation checklist today. :+1:

sarah: nit: make sure response JSON is stable and easy to store in console metrics (flat fields, counts as ints).

devon: will do. I'll ping when there's a PoC env.

anya: Thanks all — good tradeoffs.
